messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert triggered: service=redwood-inference-embed, alert=5xx_rate_high, window=5m, severity=page
PagerDuty: Automatic page fired -> @alex_r (on-call)
alex_r: Ack'd. jumping in.
june: seeing 502s on canary pool, traffic split 10% -> 2/20 instances returning 502s. cc @sre_ana
sre_ana: On it. pulling logs from canary nodes now.
alex_r: Logs show repeated upstream read errors and quick NGINX 502s. pasting snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T02:10:12Z] ERROR embed-handler: upstream read error, code=502, pid=1123
[2026-03-14T02:10:13Z] ERROR embed-runtime: worker exited unexpectedly (signal 11)
```
prod-deploy-bot: Canary rollout detected: featureflag=kv-evict-v2, version=2026.3.14-rc2, traffic=10% (started 02:05:48 UTC)
june: correlation looks tight — errors start ~02:10 (5m after rollout). hypothesis: new eviction path triggers OOM/segfault on some GPU nodes.
product_tom: Any customer-facing impact yet? CS?
customer_success_liz: One enterprise customer reported failed embeds and timeouts around 02:11 UTC. I have their ID and logs.
eng-oncall: Triage: reduce canary traffic and isolate failing replicas. Recommend immediate traffic pull to 0% and then rollback artifact.
alex_r: Mitigation plan: 1) scale canary down to 0 replicas 2) stop rollout and pin stable version 3) notify CS and hold upcoming rollouts.
sre_ana: Running command to scale down: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment canary-embed --replicas=0`
alex_r: Executing scale now.
alex_r: Scaled canary down to 0 replicas. Observing routing shift -> 5xx rate dropping from 7% to 0.9% over 120s.
june: p99 latency and error budget recovery visible in telemetry. continuing to monitor for 10m.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by alex_r. Incident state: mitigated. Auto-escalation suspended.
alex_r: Filing rollback request: revert featureflag kv-evict-v2 in flags service and pin deploys. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/flags/PR-4321 (placeholder)
product_tom: Good. We'll pause the release train and add an integration test for eviction path. Also schedule postmortem with severity P2.
customer_success_liz: Notifying affected customer: initial incident update sent, ETA for RCA 2h.
eng-oncall: Taking ownership of post-incident RCA and postmortem. Will collect core dumps, kernel OOM logs, and reproduce locally against rc2 artifact.
sre_ana: Saved pod logs and core dumps to /var/artifacts/incidents/4131239999/; linking to ticket.
alex_r: Adding runbook notes: commands executed, rollout id, timeline, mitigations.
eng-oncall: Handoff acknowledged. Will post a draft postmortem to #postmortems within 24h and tag eng/sre/product.
product_tom: :thumbsup:
alex_r: Closing on-call thread; will re-open if errors recur.
notes: Mitigated by scaling canary to 0 replicas and pausing rollout. Follow-up: RCA and postmortem assigned to eng-oncall. Customer notified.
